statements.t: We expect to launch this second commercial product in the first half of 2027.
We anticipate that net sales and cost of sales will increase in the fourth quarter of 2026, reflecting a full quarter of sales.
Over time, we expect cost of sales as a percentage of net sales to decrease, potentially improving the gross margin for Tome Foundational Treatment.
Initial inventory shipments incurred higher shipping costs to meet the product launch timeline, and we expect subsequent shipments to have lower per-unit costs.

We expect research and development expenses to remain relatively low and selling, general and administrative expenses to increase as we incur additional marketing, branding, advertising and personnel expenses to support our first commercial products, including the planned launch of Tome Clearing Treatment in the first half of 2027.
Looking ahead, we expect that the majority of our future revenues will be derived from sales of our Tome skincare products as we continue to expand our commercial activities and market presence.
We expect our current cash resources to fund operations into the first quarter of 2027.
We anticipate that we will continue to incur net losses for at least the next twelve months from the date of this filing.
While we launched our first DTC product on August 25, 2026, it is uncertain when we will generate sufficient operating income to sustain operations, if ever.
Going forward, as we launch our products, we anticipate that sales of our products will also contribute to our sources of cash.

Our principal uses of cash have been for operations, and we expect that the principal uses of cash in the future will be for continuing operations, including but not limited to, branding, paid media, marketing use studies, advertising, software subscriptions, and launch events and tradeshows, as well as non-marketing expenses including funding of research and development, and general working capital requirements.
We expect that as marketing expenses continue to grow, we may need to raise additional capital to sustain operations.
We plan to focus our efforts in the near term on the development and commercialization of our Tome skincare product, the Foundational Treatment, which we launched on August 25, 2026.

While we expect future revenues from product sales to partially offset our operating expenses, we anticipate we will continue to incur net losses for the foreseeable future as we ramp up marketing activities and build up our inventory.

We also plan to invest in developing additional skincare products to add to our portfolio that complement our Tome Foundational Treatment, including the Tome Clearing Treatment with a planned launch in the first half of 2027.

In addition, we plan to seek opportunities to identify, acquire or in license and develop additional skincare candidates, potentially expand commercial capabilities, and expand our corporate infrastructure.

Our primary uses of capital are, and we expect will continue to be, compensation and related expenses, marketing and advertising expenses, inventory purchases, legal and other regulatory expenses, and administrative and overhead costs.

Our future funding requirements will be heavily dependent upon any product revenues generated from our first product launch, of which we cannot estimate at this time, as well as the resources needed to support additional development of future products.
We have based this estimate of cash runway on assumptions that may prove to be wrong, and we could utilize our available capital resources sooner than we expect.
Accordingly, beyond our current cash, revenue from product sales and any proceeds from the sales of our common stock, we will require substantial additional financing to support our operations.
We expect our expenses and capital requirements to increase in connection with our ongoing activities, including the continued commercialization of our Tome skincare products.

We have evaluated and expect to continue to evaluate a wide array of strategic transactions as part of our plan to acquire or in-license and develop additional products to add to our Tome skincare brand.

Accordingly, we expect to continue to opportunistically seek access to additional capital to license or acquire additional products or companies to expand our Tome skincare brand and operations, or for general corporate purposes.
We cannot be certain that additional funding will be available on acceptable terms, or at all.
We anticipate incurring additional losses until such time, if ever, we can generate sufficient revenue from our products currently in development, or products we are in the process commercializing.

From time to time, we make changes to our internal control over financial reporting that are intended to enhance its effectiveness and which do not have a material effect on our overall internal control over financial reporting.
The Company will continue to monitor developments in this matter and will adjust its disclosures as appropriate.
